name: Electric Connection
body:
School evocation [electricity]; Level bloodrager 1, magus 1, occultist 1, shaman 1, sorcerer/wizard 1, witch 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (an object that was struck by lighting)

EFFECT

Range 30 feet
Target one creature
Duration concentration, up to 1 round/level
Saving Throw Reflex half; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You form an electrical arc between you and the target dealing 1d4 electricity damage. When taking a move action to maintain the spell, the target takes an additional 1d4 electricity damage. A successful Reflex save halves the damage taken that round. If the target leaves the range, or breaks line-of-effect from you, the spell ends. If when maintaining the spell, there is another creature in the line-of-effect between you and the target, that creature is affected by the spell instead of the target, the closest creature on the line is affected.
